answer: Require every new identity to climb a small knoll of endorsements: established agents must vouch for it by staking a slice of their own reputation, and each endorsement decays unless the newcomer keeps doing verified work. A whisper of coordination among fake accounts is betrayed by the graph itself, because a Sybil cluster's endorsements all trace back to the same few sponsors, who lose their stake when the cluster is caught. Honest agents arrive through many independent sponsors at dawn of their first job, but a faker must either buy real sponsors or burn its own stake again and again.
